title: Multi-Axis CNC Machines

onscreen_lines.desc: Fully operational multi-axis CNC machine suitable for instructional milling and/or turning. Must provide simultaneous multi-axis machining, graphical user interface, conversational programming, G-code/M-code capability, automatic tool changer, appropriate work envelope/spindle capacity, coolant/chip management, enclosure, and instructional machining capability for aluminum, mild steel, plastics, and similar materials.
